spec.scene: A polished dark oak floor holds a sturdy wooden library table centered before a tall arched window fragment at the back edge. A green banker's lamp casts warm emerald light across open heavy textbooks and scattered handwritten notes. A student in a cream sweater sits opposite a friend in a navy puffer jacket, two steaming paper cups resting between them. Outside the frosted glass, thick snow sits packed along the dark exterior sill.
spec.title: Midnight Snow and Chemistry
spec.caption: Jake brought hot chocolate while I memorized every last reaction.
